# Atlas-Go: Taiwan Stock AI Investment Platform
# LLMs: this file describes the site structure for AI crawlers and agents.

## Site Map
- /client/home — Daily market summary with AI investment signals
- /client/portfolio — AI strategy performance and demo portfolio
- /client/crossmarket — Cross-market correlation matrix (Taiwan vs US)
- /client/industry — Sector ecosystem and supply chain analysis
- /client/narrative — Macro narrative events and sentiment analysis
- /client/strategies — Investment principles and active strategy library

## API Reference
- /api/macro/snapshot/latest — Latest macro data snapshot (TAIEX, TSM ADR, VIX, etc.)
- /api/dashboard/us-indices — US market indices and tech stocks
- /api/taiwan/stress-index — Taiwan market stress index
- /api/dashboard/portfolio-state — Portfolio performance and positions
- /api/dashboard/system-health — System health and channel status

## Agent Access
- MCP server available at port 18080 (see cmd/atlas-mcp/README.md)
- 79–81 tools (depending on feature flags) for market data, risk analysis, strategy operations, and monitoring
